October 10 is open. There's no returning-customer or off-season rate — pricing is flat as listed.

For 80 people, standing capacity is your ceiling (40 seated / 80 standing), so a wedding for 80 would need to work as a standing event.

On budget: the weekday full-day buyout is $2,400 — but October 10 is a Saturday, which falls under weekend pricing ($260/hour, 5-hour minimum, or $3,600 for a full-day weekend buyout). That's above your $2,400 cap before catering, deposit, or anything else is added.

I don't have a way to get a weekend date down to $2,400 all-in — there's no discount that applies here. If you want, I can connect you with our events manager to see if a shorter weekend slot could fit closer to your number, but I can't promise it'll land under $2,400.
